title: Viva Glint: choose whether to retain or erase survey data for deleted users
summary: Hold: the briefing describes instance-specific settings as covering the whole tenant, although Microsoft documents independent settings and deletion requests for each Viva Glint experience. It also incorrectly excludes deleted users from the survey data retention policy, which Microsoft says applies to all Glint survey data.

claims.quote: "title": "Microsoft Viva: Viva Glint - Configure user and survey data retention for deleted users in Viva Glint", "products": ["Microsoft Viva"]

claims.claim: The roadmap describes a control allowing service administrators to retain or delete data for users deleted manually from Glint or through Microsoft Entra signals.
claims.quote: service administrators can now configure whether to retain or delete survey and relevant indefinable user data for users who are manually deleted from Glint or deleted via the signals received via Microsoft Entra.

claims.claim: The roadmap gives preservation of consistency in previously generated survey reports as a reason for the control.
claims.quote: This will ensure that the consistency of previously generate Glint survey reports is retained and user data is handled in accordance with the relevant organizational policies.

claims.claim: The deleted-user retention control is at Configuration > Service Configuration > General Settings > User Data > Retain survey responses and identifiable data for deleted users in the Viva Glint admin dashboard.
claims.quote: Select the **Configuration** symbol on your Viva Glint admin dashboard and then **General Settings** in the **Service Configuration** section. | ## User Data | ### Retain survey responses and identifiable data for deleted users

claims.claim: No API or automation for configuring deleted-user survey and identifiable data retention is documented as of November 2026.
claims.quote: Searched: Viva Glint retain survey responses identifiable deleted users settings Microsoft Graph REST API PowerShell. Opened manage-general-settings, delete-user-data, delete-user-data-faq and raw-data-request-response; no operation configuring this setting found.

claims.claim: Manual deletion is available at Configuration > Employees > People > user > Actions > Delete User in the Viva Glint admin dashboard.
claims.quote: From the admin dashboard, select the **Configuration** symbol, then in **Employees** choose **People**. | On the user's profile, select **Delete User** from the **Actions** dropdown menu.

claims.claim: No API equivalent for manual deletion of a Glint user and their data is documented.
claims.quote: Searched: Viva Glint delete user API Microsoft Graph PowerShell endpoint; site:learn.microsoft.com/viva/glint Viva Glint delete user REST API Graph PowerShell. Opened Glint deletion and DSR pages; Graph user-delete results delete directory accounts, not Glint users directly.

claims.claim: The survey retention policy is at Configuration > Service Configuration > General Settings > User Data > Data retention policy in the Viva Glint admin dashboard.
claims.quote: Select the **Configuration** symbol on your Viva Glint admin dashboard and then **General Settings** in the **Service Configuration** section. | ## User Data | ### Data retention policy

claims.claim: No API or automation configuring the Glint Data retention policy is documented.
claims.quote: Searched: Viva Glint Data retention policy API REST PowerShell configuration; site:learn.microsoft.com/viva/glint "Data retention policy" API. Opened manage-general-settings and read data-residency-for-viva-glint search excerpts; no setting operation found.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment: Security & identity; Open questions
claims.claim: Learn still states that Microsoft Entra delete-signal processing is paused until September 30, 2026.
claims.quote: Processing of delete signals from Microsoft Entra in Viva Glint is paused until September 30, 2026.

claims.claim: The FAQ says live Microsoft Entra delete-signal processing starts again from October 1, 2026.
claims.quote: Starting October 1, 2026, we will start processing these live signals once again.

claims.where: What's changing; Why it matters; Risk assessment; Governance guidance; Open questions
claims.claim: Historical Microsoft Entra delete signals received from June 2025 to September 2026 are processed under the same user data settings.
claims.quote: We will also be processing the historical delete signals received from Microsoft Entra for the period June 2025 - September 2026 following the same user data control settings.

claims.claim: Historical processing does not delete records where detected hierarchy changes caused user statuses to change.
claims.quote: During historical signal processing, user records will not be deleted if hierarchy changes were detected that caused user statuses to be modified.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Autonomy & actions; Governance guidance: After rollout
claims.claim: Microsoft advises reviewing active and inactive users for records that should have Deleted status but have not been deleted.
claims.quote: Review the list of active and inactive users to identify any users who should have a Deleted status but have not yet been deleted.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment: Data exposure; Open questions
claims.claim: From September 1, 2026, Microsoft offers only retain or erase, with no deleted-user de-identification option that preserves responses.
claims.quote: No, starting September 1, 2026 we only offer the ability for customers to either retain all survey responses and identifiable data for deleted users, including first and last name, email address and employee ID or erase all data related to the requester, including survey responses.

claims.where: Why it matters; Governance guidance: Before rollout
claims.claim: The old Delete survey data for deleted users value carries over to the new retention control with its On/Off value inverted.
claims.quote: If you previously had **Delete survey data for deleted users** set to Off, we will toggle this new control **Retain survey responses and identifiable data for deleted users** to On and vice-versa.

claims.claim: Learn says changes apply to users deleted from feature release onward, not retrospectively.
claims.quote: Changes only apply to deleted users from the point of feature release and going forward, not retrospectively.

claims.claim: Deleted Glint users are removed from distribution lists and future surveys.
claims.quote: When a user is deleted from Glint, they are removed from distribution lists and future surveys.

claims.claim: Deletion removes the user's role definitions and reporting permissions.
claims.quote: The user's role definitions and their reporting permissions are removed.

claims.claim: A deleted user's direct reports are assigned to a placeholder name that can be updated later.
claims.quote: If the user has direct reports, their reports are assigned to a placeholder name, which can be updated later.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Change & support; Governance guidance: At rollout
claims.claim: Learn says not to create a new record using the same email address or employee ID during the 30-day soft-delete period.
claims.quote: When a user is deleted, their employee record remains in a soft-deleted state for 30 days. During this period, don't create a new user record with the same email address or employee ID.

claims.claim: Reusing identifiers during soft-delete can cause upload failures or conflicts.
claims.quote: Don't create a new user record or reuse the same identifiers for another user during the 30-day soft-delete period. Reusing identifiers too soon can cause sign-in, sync, or upload conflicts.

claims.claim: The audit event's Details column shows Deleted.

claims.claim: The licensing and General Settings pages publish no separate license, meter or price for this control; the known incremental cost is administrative time.
claims.quote: Searched: Viva Glint deleted users retention setting license pricing meter charge. Opened glint-order-teams and manage-general-settings; neither names a separate license, meter or price for this control. Results describe data handling, not feature-specific billing.

claims.claim: The Data retention policy defaults to Until subscription ends.
claims.quote: | **Until subscription ends** (default) | Glint data is retained indefinitely as long as the tenant has an active Viva Glint subscription. |

claims.claim: A custom survey retention period must be between 6 and 1000 months.
claims.quote: Enter a numerical retention period (in months) to define the data retention time period. The value must be between 6-1000 months.

claims.claim: The Data retention policy is not a rule for deleted users.
claims.quote: This will apply to all Glint survey data including programs, 360 data, associated reporting conversations, actions, and more. | When the retention period is met, applicable Glint survey data is permanently deleted.
claims.fix: Replace 'and is not a rule for deleted users, so it does not replace the control above' with 'and applies to all Glint survey data; it does not replace the separate decision whether to retain or erase data when a user is deleted'. Source: https://learn.microsoft.com/viva/glint/setup/manage-general-settings#data-retention-policy.

claims.claim: No per-program or per-user value for the deleted-user retention setting is documented.
claims.quote: Searched: Viva Glint general settings user data permissions roles per survey program retain deleted users. Opened manage-general-settings and deletion pages; they state platform-level scope and all requests, with no program-specific or user-specific override.
